messages:
maria: Hey team — doing a final readiness sweep for the new weight bundle. Where are the safetensors placed in S3? I found a weights.tar but no manifest.

[simon] whisper: put the bundle under s3://redwood-models/onboard/orion-v2/weights/ but there should also be a shard_map.json next to it.

maria: I only see orion-v2-00001.safetensors ...-00004.safetensors and a README.txt. No shard_map. Is README the canonical map?

kai: README is human-friendly but the serving runtime expects shard_map.json. I opened the README — it lists tensor order but not tp layout.

olivia: quick note: tokenizer has a weird BOS token id=2 for this model (not 0). We hit a mismatch in the eval harness yesterday. Make sure tokenizer.json is the one from the conversion script.

maria: thanks. Can someone confirm dtype used for the converted safetensors? fp16 or bf16? We need to set model_config.json correctly.

ryan: converter defaulted to fp16. I ran a spot check; performance looks fine but we lost some logits precision on the quant tests. If customer wants bf16 we can re-run with bf16 flag.

maria: pinging @simon for shard_map + a quick PR to add model_config.json (tp_size, dtype, max_seq_len, kv_cache_format).

simon: on it. I have a draft shard_map, but noticed the naming pattern changed — converter wrote "orion-v2_shard_1.safetensors" vs our expected "orion-v2-00001.safetensors". Serving code uses regex to detect 00001 style. I'll normalize names and commit.

kai: FYI the conversion log had this snippet: 
```
Converting checkpoint...\n- torch dtype: float16\n- tensor-slicing: TP=4, DP=1\n- tokenizer vocab: 50256\nSaved 4 safetensors (shard indices 0..3)\n```
But the safetensors metadata shows 'safetensors_version': '0.2' which our loader doesn't accept — needs 0.1 compatibility.

olivia: oh that's the packaging toolchain issue. We upgraded safetensors lib in the CI last week. I can add a small compatibility shim, but simpler: re-export with the older pip wheel (safetensors==0.2->0.1) for this bundle.

maria: if we re-export, can we keep the fp16->bf16 option in the same job? I'd like both artifacts: fp16 shards (1) and bf16 shards (2) so we can test fallback routing in Dedicated.

ryan: yep, we can produce two bundles; it doubles S3, but ok for onboarding. I'll add a post-conversion step: `python scripts/convert_dtype.py --src fp16 --dst bf16 --out-dir bf16/` and then a quick checksum.

simon: updated shard_map.json and pushed to a branch. It maps 00001..00004 to the physical files and includes "tp_size": "4". Also added model_config.json with dtype: "fp16", max_seq_len: "4096", bos_token_id: "2".

maria: awesome. Can someone run the serve smoke test? Command I usually use: 
```
./bin/serve-local --model-dir /tmp/orion-v2 --config model_config.json --test-prompt "Hello" --timeout 10
```
and paste the logs if it fails.

ci-bot: build #3245: packaging/orion-v2 ran. Artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-models/onboard/orion-v2/ (size 12.4GB). Tests: convert (PASS), lint (PASS), pack (WARN: safetensors-version mismatch), smoke (FAIL: tokenizer BOS mismatch).

maria: CI shows smoke failed because of BOS token mismatch — that's olivia's point. Olivia, can you confirm we have the right tokenizer.json in the bundle?

olivia: tokenizer.json in the bundle had an extra special_tokens_map entry that remapped <BOS> to id 0. I removed that and re-exported from the original fast-tokenizer; new tokenizers uploaded to s3://redwood-models/onboard/orion-v2/tokenizer_v2.json.

maria: thanks. Simon/Ryan — once shard_map + tokenizer_v2 are in place, can you re-run CI? I'll watch and do a quick inference check with the eval harness.

simon: re-run kicked off. I also added a README note on naming conventions and a tiny script `normalize_names.sh` to avoid future mismatches. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/489 (draft)

ryan: CI smoke now PASS locally for me. Pushing the two bundles (fp16 + bf16) now.

ci-bot: build #3246: packaging/orion-v2 (re-run). Artifacts: fp16 shards (PASS), bf16 shards (PASS), smoke (PASS), serve-smoke (PASS).

maria: great. Final checklist before marking onboarding done: (1) shard_map.json present and validated (2) model_config.json contains tp_size, dtype, bos_token_id, max_seq_len (3) tokenizer.json matches eval harness (4) safetensors version compatible or documented shim (5) PR with normalized filenames + README. Any objections?

kai: no objections. Add an entry to the ops-checklist for future bundles: "verify safetensors metadata version and file name regex".

olivia: also add a note about tokenizer BOS id mismatch in the onboarding playbook — caught us once.

maria: perfect. I'll mark the thread as resolved after PR merged and CI green. Thanks all :thumbsup:

simon: merging now.

ryan: thanks, folks.
